description: This source file defines the implementation of an HTTP-based client for managing agent nodes, including health checks, server restarts, tool retrieval, shutdown, and status reporting within a distributed system. It includes caching, timeout and retry logic, and integrates with internal storage and interfaces.

classes.name: HTTPAgentClient
classes.description: Implements an HTTP client to communicate with agent nodes, including health monitoring, server control, and agent management functionalities.

classes.name: CachedMCPHealth
classes.description: Stores cached MCP health data along with timestamp for TTL management.

methods.name: NewHTTPAgentClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new HTTPAgentClient with specified storage provider and timeout.

methods.name: GetMCPHealth
methods.description: Retrieves MCP health info from cache or by querying the agent via HTTP.

methods.name: RestartMCPServer
methods.description: Sends a restart command for a specific MCP server on an agent node.

methods.name: GetMCPTools
methods.description: Fetches the list of tools from a specific MCP server.

methods.name: ShutdownAgent
methods.description: Requests a graceful shutdown of an agent node.

methods.name: GetAgentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed status info from an agent node with retry and timeout handling.

methods.name: getCachedHealth
methods.description: Helper to get cached MCP health data if not expired.

methods.name: cacheHealth
methods.description: Stores MCP health data in cache with current timestamp.

methods.name: invalidateCache
methods.description: Removes cached MCP health data for a specific node.

methods.name: GetCacheStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about cache entries for monitoring.

methods.name: CleanupExpiredCache
methods.description: Removes expired cache entries based on TTL.
